steps.title: Prepare HIV JR‑CSF stock
steps.instruction: Produce, concentrate, and store HIV JR‑CSF virus for mouse infection.

substeps.instruction: Plate 7.5 × 10⁶ HEK293T cells in 20 mL DMEM in a T75 flask; incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ overnight to reach 80‑85 % confluency.

Prepare transfection master mix: dilute 48 µL FuGENE 6 in 600 µL Opti‑MEM, incubate 5 min at room temperature (RT); add this to a tube containing 16 µg full‑length HIV JR‑CSF plasmid, incubate 20 min at RT, then add dropwise to the cells. Incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ overnight.
Remove old media and add 20 mL fresh D10 medium; incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ overnight.
Collect supernatant, centrifuge at 400 × g for 10 min, and transfer the clarified supernatant to a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Filter the supernatant through a 0.45 µm filter into a new 50 mL Falcon tube.
Add PEG‑it to the filtered supernatant at a 1:5 (v/v) dilution; incubate at 4 °C overnight (≥12 h).
Centrifuge the PEG‑treated supernatant at 1,500 × g, 4 °C for 30 min; discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the virus pellet in 20 mL R10 medium, aliquot, and store at –80 °C until use.

steps.title: Determine HIV stock TCID₅₀
steps.instruction: Titrate the virus using a TZM‑bl luciferase assay and calculate TCID₅₀.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL D10 medium to each well of a black 96‑well plate (TC‑treated).
Add 25 µL HIV stock to the first column and perform a 5‑fold serial dilution across the plate.
Add 1 × 10⁴ TZM‑bl cells in 100 µL D10 containing DEAE‑dextran to a final concentration of 30 µg/mL to each well.
Incubate the plate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 48 h.
Aspirate supernatant and wash cells with 200 µL PBS per well.
Dilute 5× cell‑culture lysis reagent 1:5 with distilled water to make 1×; add 30 µL to each well and shake for 15 min.
Add 50 µL Bright‑Glo luciferase substrate to each well, incubate at RT for 2 min.
Measure luminescence (e.g., SpectraMax i3x) and calculate TCID₅₀ using the provided TCID₅₀ macro.

steps.title: Isolate human memory CD4⁺ T cells
steps.instruction: Thaw PBMCs, enrich for memory CD4⁺ T cells, rest them, and verify purity by flow cytometry.

substeps.instruction: Thaw cryopreserved human PBMCs and resuspend in MACS buffer at 5 × 10⁷ cells/mL.
Perform negative selection using the EasySep™ Human Memory CD4⁺ T‑Cell Enrichment kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Resuspend the enriched mCD4⁺ T cells at 2–5 × 10⁶ cells/mL in R10‑50 medium and transfer to an appropriately sized culture flask.
Rest the cells at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for at least 5 h or overnight.

Assess purity: stain 50 µL of the cell suspension with a viability marker and the following antibodies – CD3, CD4, CD8, CD45RO, CD56, CD14, CD16, and CD19 – then analyze by flow cytometry. Proceed only if ≥95 % of cells are CD4⁺ memory T cells.
